event_layout: Opcode, exact argument arity, then 94 state words before scripted mutations. Generate: index, temple row, repeated temple row, temple column. Free: no arguments. Execute: index, animate 1, raw low byte of previous signed column, index, finite double low/high. Integer: signed integer bits. Put: fresh instance, three PA-name bytes packed little-endian, raw 725*index, initialized type/node words, finite double low/high.
state_layout: Arena and selection, followed by two arenas each with six records at indices -1,0,1,499,500,501. Each contributes signed16 row/column/type, DWORD count/first waypoint/instance tail. Each of two tracks contributes DWORD count/first/last. Twelve path and two track FNV-1a32 fingerprints cover 404 bytes each. Final output contains result, 94 state words, two full-arena and two full-512-byte-track fingerprints.
exact_write_check: Original and native adapters compare every byte of two 0x90000-byte arenas, both full 512-byte tracks, and gameData/selection before every boundary and at return. Initialization plus only the expected optional four-byte count clear is admitted before the first boundary. After a nonnull Generate callback, the expected snapshot admits only a 404-byte path copy into the fresh arena. Every callback mutation is retained. No other caller world-state writes are admitted. Compact fingerprints are separate observations; the trace does not serialize all guarded bytes. PA local storage is not world-state storage.
copy_scope: The two track sources are fully backed, disjoint from the two arena destinations, and independently patterned through all 512 guarded bytes. The first and last copied DWORDs differ. Original rep movsd copies 101 DWORDs, while native qmemcpy is memcpy. Original and recovered allocation chains corroborate a separately allocated successful path. No arbitrary overlapping-copy policy is inferred.
free_boundary: The shared native j__nfree_(void) boundary has arity zero and currently returns zero. The original-only adapter separately checks EAX equals the generated pointer, ECX is exhausted, and ESI/EDI advance by 404. Matching the native arity-zero event does not prove pointer forwarding, allocation release or native ownership correctness.
value_payload: The original reserves 24 PA local bytes and initializes only type 1 at+4 and the integer-node DWORD at+8. Proven scalar consumers read only those words, including constraint and error-print paths. The recorder reads value[1]/value[2] only; unused PA words are neither inspected nor initialized by the fixture.
register_recovery: This target sets EBP to the input index. Execute therefore carries index as its fourth argument, already correct in unchanged before; its char comes from the previous column. ECX holds 725*index and survives Execute and AddInteger, so Put argument 3 is that raw offset. Before v10 and v13 are uninitialized recovered-register artifacts. They are not repaired in the before oracle and must not be confused with movement-commit batch16 incoming-argument recovery.
distance_arithmetic: Original subtraction and absolute-value instructions wrap in 32 bits and compare the final bits as signed. INT_MIN remains negative and is accepted as within distance 1. A row distance greater than 1 skips column arithmetic. The candidate preserves this without signed overflow. Historical subtraction and abs32 signed negation remain unchanged for before measurement. Raw nonzero count values all inspect only the first waypoint; no capacity clamp or count-indexed waypoint read is assumed.
before_comparison: All four profiles match all 69 defined-before cases. The other 155 cases are excluded by their earliest reached defect: 25 signed additions, 119 uninitialized v10 reads, four abs32 negations, four signed subtractions, and three negative-int pointer widenings. The 106 original-path v13 defects overlap earlier exclusions; later original-path defects are not predictions of deterministic native execution after UB. The initial/final count expression is unsigned. In contrast, first-waypoint and copy-destination expressions begin with signed gameData+TABLE; the copy uses the post-Generate base. Pre-Execute saved-record additions and pointer widening are classified separately. No patched-before body establishes equivalence.
before_diagnostics: Clang18 O0 UBSan diagnoses all 36 earliest arithmetic/address exclusions: 33 signed arithmetic errors and three sanitizer-intercepted reads at sign-extended invalid pointers. The 119 v10-first cases are excluded statically and are not executed as equivalence oracles. An earlier GCC13 O0 UBSan high-copy/empty-return probe emitted the matching trace without diagnosing the early signed addition; its input, executable, output and stderr are retained as a sanitizer limitation, not promoted to defined behavior. The initial Clang diagnostic driver expected a raw SIGSEGV; its retained failure was corrected to recognize the sanitizer-intercepted SEGV report, with source and inputs unchanged.
address_scope: Fixed arena bases 0x10000000 and 0x7FFE0000, each 0x90000 bytes, back complete records -1,0,1,499,500,501. Track bases are 0x30000000 and 0xA0000000. Original and candidate addresses wrap at 32 bits. The caller executes before the late unsigned index<=500 and signed first-type 0..40 guards. Backing every uint32 index, arbitrary pointers, partial track sources and overlapping copies is outside this fixture.
return_scope: A final zero count returns 0, potentially after Generate/Free. Every exercised nonempty normal-return path returns 1; the slot result is ignored. Generate selectors encode null and two backed source identities, not raw pointer-equality claims. Unusual scripted mutations, raw integer-node bits and slot return bits are conditional caller-boundary probes, not claims about actual CLIPS objects or generated routes.
read_order: Entry count/first-waypoint and optional clear share a stable phase. Generate may replace gameData before the copy. Free or null Generate may change the fresh final count and captured coordinates. Execute precedes the late index/type check and fresh coordinate comparison. AddInteger precedes the fresh instance read. No callback separates the valid type 0..40 guard from the repeated type==-1 read; the latter is unreachable under the same stable storage and has no invented mutation hook.
compile_policy: GCC13 and Clang18 at O0/O2, Wall/Wextra/Werror, UBSan with only the established packed-layout alignment exception. Candidate builds have no warnings. Unchanged-before compilation narrowly allows only its existing v10/v13 uninitialized warnings; neither local is assigned by the fixture. Native mappings use MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE. The two public tests compile only the actual current body, once per optimization level for each compiler.
evidence: artifacts/readability/road-functions-20260906/batch-17/original-proof/, test-audit/native/, original-comparison.json, negative-controls/witnesses.json and before-domain-probes/. All 224 original traces supply the public per-case hashes. Public tests require only tracked source and this JSON; no original bytes or retail assets are required.
limits: Only the isolated unchanged original 604-byte caller and the native caller body execute. Generate, Free, Execute, Integer and Put are recording/mutation boundaries. Actual path generation, movement, allocation/freeing and CLIPS interning/storage do not execute.

Finite double bits include signed zero, subnormals and finite extremes. Original adapter boundaries preserve x87 state. NaNs, infinities and changes to the floating-point environment are outside this proof.
Callback mutations establish fresh caller reads and preservation in the fixture, not that every scripted mutation occurs in unmodified gameplay. No asynchronous or volatile-read contract is inferred.
The record tail at offsets 721..724 is observed as an instance argument; broader ownership or structure semantics remain unproven.
No actual Temple arrival, route, rendered frame, visual-fidelity or campaign milestone is established.
